title: Microsoft Edge: switch between Workspaces inside one window
summary: The roadmap facts, release details and both policy controls are supported. The November 25 Stable update does not change the Workspaces announcement. One minor qualification remains: Microsoft Support still describes same-window switching as coming soon for some users and documents an option to open a separate window.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Edge 158 lets users switch Workspaces in their current window instead of opening a separate window for each.
claims.quote: Users can now switch between workspaces directly within their current browser window instead of opening a separate window for each workspace.
claims.fix: After the Stable release-note paragraph, add: "The linked Microsoft Support page still calls these updates 'coming soon' and says some users may encounter them; it also documents an 'Open in a new window' option." Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/edge/getting-started-with-microsoft-edge-workspaces.
